means: Light from a large or diffused source, so shadow borders fade out over a distance instead of stopping at a line - a window on an overcast day rather than a bare bulb.
does: Widens and lightens the shadow terminator and wraps light around the far side of a face, which reads tender, flattering, forgiving. Two honest limits here. First it fights the medium: anime shading is CEL shading, flat tones with a hard border, so asking for soft shadows asks the model to abandon its default and it only half complies. Second the gradations do not separate - light.quality measured medium against soft as its closest pair at 22.40, on a card classed RECOMPOSED, so even that number is mostly the shot re-rolling rather than the light changing. Use it as one step away from hard, not as a five-position dial.
reach_for_it: for tenderness, convalescence, memory, an interior on a grey day - when a face should look kind
used_in: the soft and very_soft options of studio/cards/light_quality.json; the flat preset in studio/lighting/ ('soft even lighting')
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
